key: Hm? The entrance is sealed off.
en: Hm? The entrance is sealed off.
ja: ん? 入り口が封鎖されている。

key: SHELLY: Oh, oh, um... Okay, bye?
en: SHELLY: Oh, oh, um... Okay, bye?
ja: シェリー: あ、あの、えっと……じゃあ、またね?

key: CAIN: Aaaaaand second she sees sky, she's gone.
en: CAIN: Aaaaaand second she sees sky, she's gone.
ja: カイン: そぉーら、空を見た瞬間、もういなくなったな。

key: SHELLY: Not like I wanted to help my friend or anything...
en: SHELLY: Not like I wanted to help my friend or anything...
ja: シェリー: 別に、友達を助けたかったとかじゃないし……

key: CAIN: Heyyy, I'm still gonna go after her, all right?
en: CAIN: Heyyy, I'm still gonna go after her, all right?
ja: カイン: おーい、オレはまだあいつを追いかけるからな、いいか?

key: Just until I can make sure she's safe.
en: Just until I can make sure she's safe.
ja: 無事だって確認できるまではな。

key: I'll catch up with you guys later!
en: I'll catch up with you guys later!
ja: あとでみんなに追いつくから!

key: CHARLOTTE: See ya, princess.
en: CHARLOTTE: See ya, princess.
ja: シャルロット: またね、お姫様。

key: SHELLY: U-um... So... What exactly happened?
en: SHELLY: U-um... So... What exactly happened?
ja: シェリー: え、えっと……それで……一体何があったの?

key: CHARLOTTE: Seems like the tracks decided to just not.
en: CHARLOTTE: Seems like the tracks decided to just not.
ja: シャルロット: 線路が「もう無理」って決めたみたいね。

key: Awesome.
en: Awesome.
ja: 最高。

key: SHELLY: But... If that's the case, shouldn't the stop have been much, much, um, worse?
en: SHELLY: But... If that's the case, shouldn't the stop have been much, much, um, worse?
ja: シェリー: でも……それなら、止まる時、もっと、もっとその、ひどいことになってたんじゃ?

key: CHARLOTTE: What can I say? I'm just good like that.
en: CHARLOTTE: What can I say? I'm just good like that.
ja: シャルロット: なんて言えばいいかな。あたし、そういうの得意なだけ。

key: NOEL: Anna's practically white.
en: NOEL: Anna's practically white.
ja: ノエル: アンナ、顔真っ白だぞ。

key: ANNA: N-no, I'm fine!
en: ANNA: N-no, I'm fine!
ja: アンナ: だ、大丈夫だから!

key: It's Nostra who's not feeling well, promise!
en: It's Nostra who's not feeling well, promise!
ja: 具合悪いのはノストラの方だから、約束する!

key: CHARLOTTE: Uh huh.
en: CHARLOTTE: Uh huh.
ja: シャルロット: ふうん。

key: Then how about we get to my place so 'Nostra' can rest?
en: Then how about we get to my place so 'Nostra' can rest?
ja: それじゃ、「ノストラ」が休めるように、あたしの家に行こっか?

key: Follow me, kids.
en: Follow me, kids.
ja: ついてきな、子供たち。

key: NOEL: She says 'kids', but isn't she only a few years older than us?
en: NOEL: She says 'kids', but isn't she only a few years older than us?
ja: ノエル: 「子供」って言うけど、あの人だって僕たちとそんなに歳変わらないよね?

key: SHELLY: M-maybe it's best if we just get going...
en: SHELLY: M-maybe it's best if we just get going...
ja: シェリー: と、とにかく、進んだ方がいいかも……

key: Ah...
en: Ah...

key: It is raining?
en: It is raining?
ja: 雨、降ってる?

key: Again?
en: Again?
ja: また?

key: Why is it always raining?
en: Why is it always raining?
ja: どうしていつも雨なんだろう?

key: Who decided this?
en: Who decided this?
ja: 誰が決めたの?

key: Where can I submit a letter of complaint?
en: Where can I submit a letter of complaint?
ja: 苦情の手紙は、どこに出せばいいんだろう?

key: I wish the weather would be just a little more predictable.
en: I wish the weather would be just a little more predictable.
ja: 天気がもう少し予測できたらいいのに。

key: I wish I could tell someone something like "stablweather" and it would always cycle in the same reliable fashion...
en: I wish I could tell someone something like "stablweather" and it would always cycle in the same reliable fashion...
ja: 誰かに「せいじょうきこう」とでも言えば、いつも決まった周期で天気が変わるようになる……なんてことがあればいいのに……

key: ...If only...
en: ...If only...
ja: ……そうだったらいいのに……
